claim: Oura: Space-separated. Left blank, the app requests every scope; the user can switch scopes off at consent.

claim: Oura: PKCE Recommended. code_challenge_method must be S256; the verifier is 43 to 128 characters, hashed with SHA-256 and base64url-encoded without padding.
quote: between 43 and 128 characters long (inclusive), then hash it with SHA256 and encode the digest in base64url format without padding

claim: Oura: refresh. grant_type=refresh_token at the token URL returns a new access token and a new refresh token; each refresh token works once.
quote: The refresh token is single-use, meaning it is invalidated after being used.

claim: Oura: lifetime. Returned in expires_in. The page states no fixed number for the server-side flow; the client-side flow's token is currently 30 days and has no refresh token.
quote: Once a token expires (currently set to 30 days), the user will need to re-authenticate your app.

claim: Oura: Client credentials go in the form body or as HTTP Basic (client_id as user name, client_secret as password).
quote: Instead of providing client_id and client_secret as parameters, they can be given using the HTTP Basic Authorization, with client_id as username and client_secret as password.

claim: Oura: Every request to the Oura API needs a non-empty User-Agent header, so the commands below send one.
quote: All requests to the Oura API must include a non-empty User-Agent header.

claim: Oura: Revoke a token with GET https://api.ouraring.com/oauth/revoke?access_token=….
quote: https://api.ouraring.com/oauth/revoke?access_token={access_token}

claim: WHOOP: authorization URL https://api.prod.whoop.com/oauth/oauth2/auth. Authorization URL (the API reference's authorizationCode flow).
quote: Authorization URL: https://api.prod.whoop.com/oauth/oauth2/auth

claim: WHOOP: token URL https://api.prod.whoop.com/oauth/oauth2/token. Token URL, also used for refresh.
quote: Token URL: https://api.prod.whoop.com/oauth/oauth2/token

claim: WHOOP: scope read:recovery grants Recovery data, including score, heart rate variability, and resting heart rate.
quote: read:recovery - Read Recovery data, including score, heart rate variability, and resting heart rate.

claim: WHOOP: scope read:cycles grants Cycles data, including day Strain and average heart rate during a physiological cycle.
quote: read:cycles - Read cycles data, including day Strain and average heart rate during a physiological cycle.

claim: WHOOP: scope read:workout grants Workout data, including activity Strain and average heart rate.

claim: WHOOP: scope read:sleep grants Sleep data, including performance % and duration per sleep stage.

claim: WHOOP: scope read:profile grants Profile data, including name and email.

claim: WHOOP: scope read:body_measurement grants Body measurements data, including height, weight, and max heart rate.
quote: read:body_measurement - Read body measurements data, including height, weight, and max heart rate.

claim: WHOOP: scope offline grants A refresh token; without it WHOOP issues none.
quote: You must request the offline scope to receive a refresh token.

claim: WHOOP: The pages read here do not state the separator for the authorize request. WHOOP's sample token response lists granted scopes separated by spaces, so this tool joins them with spaces.
quote: "scope" : "offline other-scopes-requested"

claim: WHOOP: refresh. Using the refresh token invalidates the existing access tokens; the refresh token in the response replaces the old one, and of two simultaneous refreshes only the first succeeds.
quote: Existing access tokens are invalidated once your app uses the refresh token to generate a new access token.

claim: WHOOP: lifetime. Returned in expires_in, in seconds; WHOOP's sample refresh response shows 3600.
quote: WHOOP provides the token expiry in the expires_in parameter

claim: WHOOP: If you generate state yourself it must be eight characters long; this tool generates eight.
quote: The state parameter must be eight characters long if you need to generate it yourself.

claim: WHOOP: The redirect URL must be registered in the WHOOP Developer Dashboard.
quote: You must register the Redirect URL in the WHOOP Developer Dashboard.

claim: WHOOP: WHOOP's sample refresh payload sends client_id, client_secret and scope offline in the body.
quote: "scope" : "offline"

claim: Strava: scope read grants Public segments, public routes, public profile data, public posts, public events, club feeds, and leaderboards.

claim: Strava: scope read_all grants Private routes, private segments, and private events for the user.
quote: read private routes, private segments, and private events for the user

claim: Strava: scope profile:read_all grants All profile information, even if the user set profile visibility to Followers or Only You.

claim: Strava: scope profile:write grants Update the user's weight and Functional Threshold Power (FTP), and star or unstar segments.

claim: Strava: scope activity:read grants Activities visible to Everyone and Followers, excluding privacy zone data; required for activity webhooks.

claim: Strava: Required. Comma- or space-delimited; this tool uses commas. The athlete can untick any requested scope, so check the scope the redirect returns.
quote: Requested scopes, as a comma- or URL-safe space-delimited string

claim: Strava: refresh. Refresh with grant_type=refresh_token. If the current access token expires in more than an hour, the same one comes back; once a new refresh token is returned the old one stops working.
quote: Once a new refresh token is returned, the older refresh token is invalidated immediately.

claim: Strava: lifetime. Six hours from creation.
quote: Access tokens expire six hours after they are created

claim: Strava: The authorization code is short-lived and single-use.
quote: code is short lived and can only be used once.

claim: Strava: approval_prompt is auto by default; force always shows the prompt.
quote: use force to always show the authorization prompt even if the user has already authorized the current application, default is auto

claim: Strava: localhost and 127.0.0.1 are allowed as redirect hosts.
quote: localhost and 127.0.0.1 are white-listed.

claim: Strava: Deauthorize with POST https://www.strava.com/oauth/revoke (HTTP Basic, the token in the body), the only supported endpoint from June 1, 2027.

claim: Polar AccessLink: scope accesslink.read_all grants Access to the user's data.

claim: Polar AccessLink: Optional: without it the user is asked to grant every scope linked to your client.
